about_the_game:
Crazyness: Weird Village, is a first-person game
of action and suspense.
In the plot; Jacob and Mily fall into a trap,
Family that once lived in tranquility,
has his dreams stolen by mysterious people.
Jacob will have to face great challenges,
where a secret and macabre system will try everything
to eliminate it.
